verdict.rationale: Authy has a developer API, so an interactive API reference is a fair question. The evidence shows only that SDKs exist for common web languages and that the Authy API is closed to new customers and slated for deprecation. Nothing describes an interactive, explorable API reference with runnable examples. The 'few lines of code' claim is about the separate Verify API, so it does not count for Authy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
